scope: Isolated nine independent K1115A parameter pairs (SYSPER2/4/16,FREQ10/20/50MHz). Original signed arithmetic retained verbatim. Matched50MHz negative-edge external staging/positive-edge launch/capture,20ns embedded paths,2ns max0ns min virtual I/O. Counts include shell/admin/pruning; no timer correction/full board/global snapshot or speed claim.

manifest.scope:
Exact modeled K1115A accumulator state; no oscillator-rate/timer correction.

The original signed 32-bit accumulator, output and parameter arithmetic are
preserved, including wrap behavior. Caller must hold every consumer/input.
manifest.parameters: Original FREQ_KHZ/SYSPER arithmetic retained verbatim, not a calibrated real-time oscillator
